# Purv Taparia — Personal Portfolio

> Purv Taparia is a student in Grade 5 at Chatrabhuj Narsee School, Mumbai, India. He is a young AI builder who ships apps with Claude Code, a 5× published author, two-time International Rank 1 English Olympiad winner, coder, newsletter blogger, Arduino-certified maker, and national-level roller skating competitor.

## About

Purv Taparia (born ~2016, Mumbai, India) is a prodigious student with achievements spanning academic Olympiads, creative writing, hardware engineering, and software development. He studies at Chatrabhuj Narsee School (cns.ac.in), Mumbai.

**Roles:** Student · AI Builder (Claude Code) · Published Author · Developer · Newsletter Blogger · Roller Skater

**Location:** Mumbai, India

## Projects

- **Envoy** — Private, local-first AI workspace for Model UN delegates: research vault with cited chat, AI drafting studio with Word/PDF export, opponent simulator, committee timers, teleprompter and shareable per-conference workspaces, running locally via Ollama (Next.js, FastAPI, ChromaDB, Ollama; built with Claude Code) [Sep 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/envoy
- **Neo-Pixel Game** — 30-second apple-catching arcade game on an 8×8 NeoPixel grid: a 3-LED paddle moved with push buttons catches falling apples (+1 per catch, −2 per miss), a second apple joins after 10 seconds and speed rises 3% each second; Arduino Uno in a battery-powered 3D-printed case with piezo sound effects (Arduino, C++, NeoPixels, Piezo) [Jan 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/neopixel-game
- **Air Quality Monitor** — Pocket-sized air quality monitor built during the Delhi smog crisis: MQ135 gas sensor + Arduino Nano, with a 128×64 OLED showing the live reading and a verdict like "Hazardous", in a 3D-printed case (Arduino Nano, C++, MQ135, OLED) [Nov 2025] — https://youtube.com/shorts/qGbcmELwwhQ
- **Radar System** — Ultrasonic sensor on a 180° servo sweeps the room while an Arduino UNO measures distances; a radar screen coded in Processing plots detected objects in real time (Arduino UNO, C++, Ultrasonic, Servo, Processing) [May 2026] — https://youtube.com/shorts/xNrgtW_awv8
- **Rapid Games** — Free online gaming platform built with Ridit and Devansh (HTML/CSS/JS, GitHub Pages) [Oct 2025] — https://tapariapurv.github.io/rapidgames
- **LiteWarden** — Chrome extension for local password management (JavaScript, Chrome APIs; built with Claude Code) [Jan 2026, in progress] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/chrome-extension
- **Antigravity Usage Monitor** — Analytics dashboard for Google Antigravity (Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite; built with Claude Code) [Jun 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/antigravity-usage-monitor
- **Logek** — Adaptive vocabulary learning app with spaced repetition and gamification (React, TypeScript, Firebase; built with Claude Code) [Aug 2026] — https://tapariapurv.github.io/Logek
- **Market Alert Matrix** — ESP8266 + 16-LED NeoPixel ring device in a 3D-printed case that shows the market's live move from the previous close (one LED per 0.2%) and sounds a piezo alarm past 1% (ESP8266, C++, NeoPixels, APIs) [Aug 2026]
- **Velvet Pour** — GSAP-animated cocktail brand landing page (React, GSAP, Tailwind CSS) [Aug 2026] — https://cocktail-site-lac.vercel.app/
- **Indian Stock Data Hub** — Open-source research desk for Indian listed companies with local AI analysis and Excel/Word reports (Python, Streamlit, Ollama; built with Claude Code) [Sep 2026] — https://github.com/tapariapurv/indian-stock-data-hub
